import math

int locate(string needle, string[] values)
    for: 0 <= k < int(#values)
        if needle == values[k]
            return k
    return -1

int integer_value(string value)
    return int(value)

string pair(int a, int b)
    return "{a}-{b}"

int stat(int side, int metric)
    return 24 + 16 * side + metric

void put(int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int slot, int value)
    if values[slot] != value
        position := int32(slot)
        previous := int32(values[slot])
        delta = delta.append(position).append(previous)
        values[slot] = value

void add(int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int slot, amount := 1)
    put(&values, &delta, slot, values[slot] + amount)

class Darts(string[] labels, int[] points, bool[] doubles)

Darts dart_table()
    string[] labels := []
    int[] points := []
    bool[] doubles := []
    for: 0 <= group < 3
        for: 20 >= number >= 1 step -1
            labels = labels.append(["S", "T", "D"][group] + string(number))
            points = points.append(number * [1, 3, 2][group])
            doubles = doubles.append(group == 2)
    return Darts(labels.concat(["25", "BULL", "MISS"]), points.concat([25, 50, 0]), doubles.concat([false, true, false]))

int finishing_dart(int score)
    if score == 50
        return 61
    return if 2 <= score <= 40 and score % 2 == 0 then 60 - score / 2 else -1

int[] checkout(const Darts darts, int score, int allowance)
    last := finishing_dart(score)
    if last >= 0 and allowance >= 1
        return [last]
    if allowance >= 2
        for: 0 <= first < 62
            last = finishing_dart(score - darts.points[first])
            if last >= 0
                return [first, last]
    if allowance >= 3
        for: 0 <= first < 62
            for: 0 <= second < 62
                last = finishing_dart(score - darts.points[first] - darts.points[second])
                if last >= 0
                    return [first, second, last]
    return []

string dart_names(const Darts darts, int[] sequence)
    return darts.labels[sequence].join(" ")

class Match(string id, int sport, string[] names, int[] options, int[][] initial_lineups, int[] values, int32[] history, int history_used)

int tennis_mode(int[] values, int[] options)
    target := options[0] / 2 + 1
    final_set := values[4] == target - 1 and values[5] == target - 1
    if final_set and options[2] == 3
        return 2
    if values[2] == 6 and values[3] == 6 and not (final_set and options[2] == 2)
        return 1
    return 0

int server(int sport, int[] values, int[] options)
    if sport == 0
        if tennis_mode(values, options) != 0
            return (values[6] + ((values[0] + values[1] + 1) / 2) % 2) % 2
        return values[6]
    if sport == 1
        rallies := values[0] + values[1]
        changes := if rallies < 20 then rallies / 2 else rallies
        return (options[3] + values[9] + changes) % 2
    return values[6]

void finished_set(int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int a, int b, lost := -1, kind := 0)
    base := 68 + 4 * values[9]
    put(&values, &delta, base, a)
    put(&values, &delta, base + 1, b)
    put(&values, &delta, base + 2, lost)
    put(&values, &delta, base + 3, kind)
    add(&values, &delta, 9)

bool normal_game_won(int[] values, int side, int[] options)
    return values[side] >= 4 and (options[1] == 1 or values[side] - values[1 - side] >= 2)

void rally(int sport, int[] options, int[][] initial_lineups, int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int side)
    serving := server(sport, values, options)
    mode := if sport == 0 then tennis_mode(values, options) else 0
    if sport == 0 and mode == 0
        receiving := 1 - serving
        hypothetical := values
        hypothetical[receiving] += 1
        if normal_game_won(hypothetical, receiving, options)
            add(&values, &delta, stat(receiving, 7))
            if side == receiving
                add(&values, &delta, stat(receiving, 8))
    add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 0))
    add(&values, &delta, stat(serving, 1))
    if serving == side
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 2))
    run_length := if values[10] == side then values[11] + 1 else 1
    put(&values, &delta, 10, side)
    put(&values, &delta, 11, run_length)
    put(&values, &delta, stat(side, 3), math.max(values[stat(side, 3)], run_length))
    add(&values, &delta, side)
    ended := false
    if sport == 0
        if mode == 0
            if not normal_game_won(values, side, options)
                return
            add(&values, &delta, stat(serving, 5))
            if side == serving
                add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 4))
            else
                add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 6))
            add(&values, &delta, 2 + side)
            put(&values, &delta, 0, 0)
            put(&values, &delta, 1, 0)
            ended = values[2 + side] >= 6 and values[2 + side] - values[3 - side] >= 2
            if ended
                finished_set(&values, &delta, values[2], values[3])
        else
            final_set := values[4] == options[0] / 2 and values[5] == options[0] / 2
            target := if mode == 2 or (final_set and options[2] == 1) then 10 else 7
            if values[side] < target or values[side] - values[1 - side] < 2
                return
            if mode == 2
                finished_set(&values, &delta, values[0], values[1], -1, 2)
            else
                add(&values, &delta, 2 + side)
                finished_set(&values, &delta, values[2], values[3], values[1 - side], 1)
            ended = true
        add(&values, &delta, 12)
        put(&values, &delta, 6, 1 - values[6])
    elif sport == 1
        ended = values[side] >= 11 and values[side] - values[1 - side] >= 2
    elif sport == 2
        put(&values, &delta, 6, side)
        ended = values[side] >= 30 or (values[side] >= 21 and values[side] - values[1 - side] >= 2)
    else
        if values[6] != side
            put(&values, &delta, 6, side)
            base := 56 + 6 * side
            first := values[base]
            for: 0 <= k < 5
                put(&values, &delta, base + k, values[base + k + 1])
            put(&values, &delta, base + 5, first)
        target := if values[9] == 4 then 15 else 25
        ended = values[side] >= target and values[side] - values[1 - side] >= 2
    if not ended
        return
    if sport != 0
        finished_set(&values, &delta, values[0], values[1])
    add(&values, &delta, 4 + side)
    target := if sport == 0 or sport == 1 then options[0] / 2 + 1 elif sport == 2 then 2 else 3
    if values[4 + side] == target
        put(&values, &delta, 7, 1)
        put(&values, &delta, 8, side)
        return
    for: 0 <= k < 4
        put(&values, &delta, k, 0)
    if sport == 3
        put(&values, &delta, 6, (options[3] + values[9]) % 2)
        for: 0 <= team < 2
            put(&values, &delta, stat(team, 9), 0)
            put(&values, &delta, stat(team, 10), 0)
            for: 0 <= k < 6
                put(&values, &delta, 56 + 6 * team + k, initial_lineups[team][k])

void roll(int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int pins)
    frame := values[17]
    ball := values[18]
    mark := if values[20] == 1 and pins == 10 then 10 elif pins == values[19] then 11 else pins
    put(&values, &delta, 104 + 3 * frame + ball, pins)
    put(&values, &delta, 137 + 3 * frame + ball, mark)
    add(&values, &delta, 21)
    standing := values[19] - pins
    frame_done := false
    if frame < 9
        frame_done = (ball == 0 and pins == 10) or ball == 1
    else
        first := values[131]
        frame_done = ball == 2 or (ball == 1 and first != 10 and first + pins < 10)
    if frame_done
        base := 104 + 3 * frame
        if values[base] != 10 and ball >= 1 and values[base] + values[base + 1] < 10
            add(&values, &delta, 22)
        if frame == 9
            put(&values, &delta, 7, 1)
        else
            put(&values, &delta, 17, frame + 1)
            put(&values, &delta, 18, 0)
            put(&values, &delta, 19, 10)
            put(&values, &delta, 20, 1)
    else
        put(&values, &delta, 18, ball + 1)
        reset := frame == 9 and standing == 0
        put(&values, &delta, 19, if reset then 10 else standing)
        put(&values, &delta, 20, if reset then 1 else 0)

int[] bowling_scores(int[] values)
    int[] rolls := []
    int[] starts := []
    for: 0 <= frame < 10
        starts = starts.append(int(#rolls))
        for: 0 <= ball < 3
            pins := values[104 + 3 * frame + ball]
            if pins >= 0
                rolls = rolls.append(pins)
    result := array(10, fill = -1)
    cumulative := 0
    for: 0 <= frame < 10
        base := 104 + 3 * frame
        first := values[base]
        second := values[base + 1]
        if first < 0
            break
        score := -1
        if frame == 9
            if values[7] == 1
                score = first + math.max(0, second) + math.max(0, values[base + 2])
        elif first == 10
            if starts[frame] + 2 < int(#rolls)
                score = 10 + rolls[starts[frame] + 1] + rolls[starts[frame] + 2]
        elif second >= 0
            if first + second < 10
                score = first + second
            elif starts[frame] + 2 < int(#rolls)
                score = 10 + rolls[starts[frame] + 2]
        if score >= 0
            cumulative += score
            result[frame] = cumulative
    return result

void complete_turn(int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int side)
    scored := values[16]
    put(&values, &delta, stat(side, 3), math.max(values[stat(side, 3)], scored))
    if scored >= 100
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 4))
    if scored == 180
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 5))

void next_turn(int[] &values, int32[] &delta)
    put(&values, &delta, 6, 1 - values[6])
    put(&values, &delta, 14, 0)
    put(&values, &delta, 16, 0)
    put(&values, &delta, 15, values[values[6]])

void throw_dart(const Darts darts, int[] options, int[] &values, int32[] &delta, int dart)
    side := values[6]
    before := values[side]
    scored := darts.points[dart]
    remaining := before - scored
    add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 0))
    if before == 50 or (before <= 40 and before % 2 == 0)
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 6))
    if remaining < 0 or remaining == 1 or (remaining == 0 and not darts.doubles[dart])
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 2))
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 1), -values[16])
        put(&values, &delta, side, values[15])
        next_turn(&values, &delta)
        return
    put(&values, &delta, side, remaining)
    add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 1), scored)
    put(&values, &delta, 134 + values[14], dart)
    add(&values, &delta, 14)
    add(&values, &delta, 16, scored)
    if remaining == 0
        add(&values, &delta, stat(side, 7))
        complete_turn(&values, &delta, side)
        add(&values, &delta, 2 + side)
        set_done := values[2 + side] == options[5]
        if set_done
            finished_set(&values, &delta, values[2], values[3])
            add(&values, &delta, 4 + side)
            if values[4 + side] == options[0]
                put(&values, &delta, 7, 1)
                put(&values, &delta, 8, side)
                return
            put(&values, &delta, 2, 0)
            put(&values, &delta, 3, 0)
        add(&values, &delta, 13)
        put(&values, &delta, 0, options[4])
        put(&values, &delta, 1, options[4])
        put(&values, &delta, 6, (options[3] + values[13]) % 2)
        put(&values, &delta, 14, 0)
        put(&values, &delta, 15, options[4])
        put(&values, &delta, 16, 0)
    elif values[14] == 3
        complete_turn(&values, &delta, side)
        next_turn(&values, &delta)

string set_text(int[] values, int index, reverse := false)
    base := 68 + 4 * index
    a := values[base + (if reverse then 1 else 0)]
    b := values[base + (if reverse then 0 else 1)]
    text := pair(a, b)
    if values[base + 3] == 2
        return "[" + text + "]"
    if values[base + 3] == 1
        text += "(" + string(values[base + 2]) + ")"
    return text

string situation(const Match game, int side)
    hypothetical := game.values
    int32[] changes := []
    rally(game.sport, game.options, game.initial_lineups, &hypothetical, &changes, side)
    if hypothetical[7] == 1
        return "match point"
    if hypothetical[9] > game.values[9]
        return if game.sport == 1 or game.sport == 2 then "game point" else "set point"
    if game.sport == 0 and hypothetical[12] > game.values[12]
        return if server(game.sport, game.values, game.options) == side then "game point" else "break point"
    return ""

string score_text(const Match game, const Darts darts)
    values := game.values
    result := game.id + ": "
    if game.sport == 4
        result += game.names[0]
        scores := bowling_scores(values)
        for: 0 <= frame < 10
            if values[104 + 3 * frame] < 0
                break
            marks := ""
            for: 0 <= ball < 3
                mark := values[137 + 3 * frame + ball]
                if mark >= 0
                    marks += if mark == 10 then "X" elif mark == 11 then "/" elif mark == 0 then "-" else string(mark)
            result += " " + marks
            if scores[frame] >= 0
                result += "(" + string(scores[frame]) + ")"
        return result
    serving := server(game.sport, values, game.options)
    result += game.names[0] + (if values[7] == 0 and serving == 0 then "*" else "") + " vs " + game.names[1] + (if values[7] == 0 and serving == 1 then "*" else "")
    if game.sport == 5
        result += " sets " + pair(values[4], values[5]) + " legs " + pair(values[2], values[3]) + " score " + pair(values[0], values[1])
        if values[7] == 0
            if values[14] > 0
                result += " turn " + dart_names(darts, values[134:<134 + values[14]])
            finish := checkout(darts, values[serving], 3 - values[14])
            if #finish > 0
                result += " checkout " + dart_names(darts, finish)
        return result
    for: 0 <= k < values[9]
        result += " " + set_text(values, k)
    if values[7] == 0
        if game.sport == 0
            mode := tennis_mode(values, game.options)
            if mode == 2
                result += " [" + pair(values[0], values[1]) + "]"
            else
                points := pair(values[0], values[1])
                if mode == 0
                    if game.options[1] == 0 and values[0] >= 3 and values[1] >= 3
                        points = if values[0] == values[1] then "40-40" elif values[0] > values[1] then "AD-40" else "40-AD"
                    else
                        labels := ["0", "15", "30", "40"]
                        points = labels[values[0]] + "-" + labels[values[1]]
                result += " " + pair(values[2], values[3]) + " " + points
        else
            result += " " + pair(values[0], values[1])
            if game.sport == 3
                result += " server " + string(values[56 + 6 * serving])
        for: 0 <= side < 2
            status := situation(game, side)
            if status != ""
                result += " (" + status + " " + game.names[side] + ")"
    return result

string[] stats_text(const Match game)
    values := game.values
    string[] output := []
    if game.sport == 4
        strikes := 0
        spares := 0
        for: 137 <= k < 167
            if values[k] == 10
                strikes += 1
            elif values[k] == 11
                spares += 1
        possible := values
        int32[] ignored := []
        while possible[7] == 0
            roll(&possible, &ignored, possible[19])
        return [game.id + " " + game.names[0] + ": strikes " + string(strikes) + " spares " + string(spares) + " open " + string(values[22]) + " max " + string(bowling_scores(possible)[9])]
    for: 0 <= side < 2
        base := stat(side, 0)
        result := game.id + " " + game.names[side] + ": "
        if game.sport == 5
            average := if values[base] == 0 then 0 else values[base + 1] * 300 / values[base]
            result += "darts " + string(values[base]) + " average " + "{average / 100}.{average % 100:02.}" + " busts " + string(values[base + 2]) + " high " + string(values[base + 3]) + " tons " + string(values[base + 4]) + " 180s " + string(values[base + 5]) + " doubles " + string(values[base + 7]) + "/" + string(values[base + 6])
        else
            result += "points " + string(values[base]) + " serve " + string(values[base + 2]) + "/" + string(values[base + 1]) + " run " + string(values[base + 3])
            if game.sport == 0
                result += " holds " + string(values[base + 4]) + "/" + string(values[base + 5]) + " breaks " + string(values[base + 6]) + " break points " + string(values[base + 8]) + "/" + string(values[base + 7])
            elif game.sport == 3
                lineup := [for k := (0:<6)[] then string(values[56 + 6 * side + k])]
                result += " subs " + string(values[base + 9]) + " timeouts " + string(values[base + 10]) + " lineup " + lineup.join(",")
        output = output.append(result)
    return output

string event(const Darts darts, Match &game, string command, string[] tokens)
    if game.values[7] == 1
        return "ERROR match over"
    int32[] delta := []
    if command == "POINT"
        side := if tokens[0] == "A" then 0 else 1
        rally(game.sport, game.options, game.initial_lineups, &game.values, &delta, side)
    elif command == "ROLL"
        pins := integer_value(tokens[0])
        if pins > game.values[19]
            return "ERROR too many pins"
        roll(&game.values, &delta, pins)
    elif command == "THROW"
        dart := locate(tokens[0], darts.labels)
        if dart < 0
            return "ERROR invalid dart"
        throw_dart(darts, game.options, &game.values, &delta, dart)
    else
        side := if tokens[0] == "A" then 0 else 1
        if command == "TIMEOUT"
            if game.values[stat(side, 10)] >= 2
                return "ERROR no timeouts left"
            add(&game.values, &delta, stat(side, 10))
        else
            outgoing := integer_value(tokens[1])
            incoming := integer_value(tokens[2])
            position := -1
            present := false
            for: 0 <= k < 6
                shirt := game.values[56 + 6 * side + k]
                if shirt == outgoing
                    position = k
                if shirt == incoming
                    present = true
            if position < 0
                return "ERROR player not on court"
            if present
                return "ERROR player already on court"
            if game.values[stat(side, 9)] >= 6
                return "ERROR no substitutions left"
            put(&game.values, &delta, 56 + 6 * side + position, incoming)
            add(&game.values, &delta, stat(side, 9))
    delta_length := int(#delta)
    required := game.history_used + delta_length + 1
    capacity := int(#game.history)
    if required > capacity
        capacity = math.max(16, capacity)
        while capacity < required
            capacity *= 2
        int32 zero := 0
        expanded := array(nat(capacity), fill = zero)
        for: 0 <= k < game.history_used
            expanded[k] = game.history[k]
        game.history = expanded
    for: 0 <= k < delta_length
        game.history[game.history_used + k] = delta[k]
    size := int32(delta_length)
    game.history[game.history_used + delta_length] = size
    game.history_used = required
    return ""

string[] execute(string input_line, Match[] &games, const Darts darts)
    fields := input_line.split(" ")
    command := fields[0]
    if command == "CHECKOUT"
        score := integer_value(fields[1])
        finish := checkout(darts, score, 3)
        return ["checkout " + string(score) + ": " + (if #finish == 0 then "none" else dart_names(darts, finish))]
    if command == "STANDINGS"
        string[] names := []
        int[] wins := []
        int[] losses := []
        for game := games[]
            if game.sport == 4 or game.values[7] == 0
                continue
            for: 0 <= side < 2
                k := locate(game.names[side], names)
                if k < 0
                    k = int(#names)
                    names = names.append(game.names[side])
                    wins = wins.append(0)
                    losses = losses.append(0)
                if side == game.values[8]
                    wins[k] += 1
                else
                    losses[k] += 1
        ordered := names.sorted()
        for: 1 <= k < int(#ordered)
            current := ordered[k]
            current_id := locate(current, names)
            p := k
            while p > 0
                previous_id := locate(ordered[p - 1], names)
                if wins[previous_id] > wins[current_id] or (wins[previous_id] == wins[current_id] and losses[previous_id] <= losses[current_id])
                    break
                ordered[p] = ordered[p - 1]
                p -= 1
            ordered[p] = current
        string[] items := []
        for name := ordered[]
            k := locate(name, names)
            items = items.append(name + " " + pair(wins[k], losses[k]))
        return ["standings: " + (if #items == 0 then "none" else items.join(", "))]
    match_id := -1
    for: 0 <= k < int(#games)
        if games[k].id == fields[1]
            match_id = k
    if command == "MATCH"
        if match_id >= 0
            return ["ERROR duplicate match"]
        sport := locate(fields[2], ["TENNIS", "TABLETENNIS", "BADMINTON", "VOLLEYBALL", "BOWLING", "DARTS"])
        string[] names := if sport == 4 then [fields[3]] else [fields[3], fields[4]]
        options := [3, 0, 0, 0, 501, 1]
        if sport == 1
            options[0] = 5
        elif sport == 5
            options[0] = 1
        int[][] lineups := [[], []]
        option_start := if sport == 4 then 4 elif sport == 3 then 7 else 5
        if sport == 3
            for: 0 <= side < 2
                for shirt := fields[5 + side].split(",")[]
                    lineups[side] = lineups[side].append(integer_value(shirt))
        string[] used := []
        for: option_start <= k < int(#fields)
            option := fields[k].split("=")
            if #option != 2 or locate(option[0], used) >= 0
                return ["ERROR invalid option"]
            used = used.append(option[0])
            key := option[0]
            value := option[1]
            if key == "FIRST" and sport != 4 and (value == "A" or value == "B")
                options[3] = if value == "A" then 0 else 1
            elif key == "SETS" and sport == 0 and (value == "3" or value == "5")
                options[0] = integer_value(value)
            elif key == "GAMES" and sport == 1 and (value == "5" or value == "7")
                options[0] = integer_value(value)
            elif key == "DEUCE" and sport == 0 and (value == "AD" or value == "NOAD")
                options[1] = if value == "NOAD" then 1 else 0
            elif key == "FINAL" and sport == 0 and locate(value, ["TB7", "TB10", "ADV", "SUPER"]) >= 0
                options[2] = locate(value, ["TB7", "TB10", "ADV", "SUPER"])
            elif key == "START" and sport == 5 and (value == "301" or value == "501" or value == "701")
                options[4] = integer_value(value)
            elif (key == "SETS" or key == "LEGS") and sport == 5 and locate(value, ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5"]) >= 0
                options[if key == "SETS" then 0 else 5] = integer_value(value)
            else
                return ["ERROR invalid option"]
        values := array(167, fill = 0)
        values[6] = options[3]
        values[8] = -1
        values[10] = -1
        values[19] = 10
        values[20] = 1
        for: 104 <= k < 134
            values[k] = -1
        for: 137 <= k < 167
            values[k] = -1
        if sport == 3
            for: 0 <= side < 2
                for: 0 <= k < 6
                    values[56 + 6 * side + k] = lineups[side][k]
        elif sport == 5
            values[0] = options[4]
            values[1] = options[4]
            values[15] = options[4]
        games = games.append(Match(fields[1], sport, names, options, lineups, values, [], 0))
        return []
    if match_id < 0
        return ["ERROR unknown match"]
    if command == "UNDO"
        size := games[match_id].history_used
        if size == 0
            return ["ERROR nothing to undo"]
        count := int(games[match_id].history[size - 1])
        p := size - 3
        begin := size - count - 1
        while p >= begin
            slot := int(games[match_id].history[p])
            games[match_id].values[slot] = int(games[match_id].history[p + 1])
            p -= 2
        games[match_id].history_used = begin
        return []
    if command == "SCORE"
        return [score_text(games[match_id], darts)]
    if command == "STATS"
        return stats_text(games[match_id])
    if command == "RESULT"
        game := games[match_id]
        if game.values[7] == 0
            return ["ERROR match not finished"]
        if game.sport == 4
            return [game.id + ": " + game.names[0] + " " + string(bowling_scores(game.values)[9])]
        winner := game.values[8]
        result := game.id + ": " + game.names[winner] + " def. " + game.names[1 - winner]
        for: 0 <= k < game.values[9]
            result += " " + set_text(game.values, k, winner == 1)
        return [result]
    sport := games[match_id].sport
    if (command == "POINT" and sport > 3) or (command == "ROLL" and sport != 4) or (command == "THROW" and sport != 5) or ((command == "SUB" or command == "TIMEOUT") and sport != 3)
        return ["ERROR wrong event"]
    if command == "POINT"
        for: 0 <= k < int(#fields[2])
            problem := event(darts, &games[match_id], command, [fields[2][k]])
            if problem != ""
                return [problem]
    elif command == "ROLL" or command == "THROW"
        for: 2 <= k < int(#fields)
            problem := event(darts, &games[match_id], command, [fields[k]])
            if problem != ""
                return [problem]
    else
        problem := event(darts, &games[match_id], command, fields[2:])
        if problem != ""
            return [problem]
    return []
